dimensions.assessment: Applies broadly to all U.S. federal departments and agencies regarding diplomatic and official interactions involving South Ossetia and Abkhazia.
dimensions.evidence: no Federal department or agency may take any action or extend any assistance that implies recognition

dimensions.assessment: Prohibits any federal action or assistance implying recognition of sovereignty for the specified regions.
dimensions.evidence: no Federal department or agency may take any action or extend any assistance that implies recognition of the claims of sovereignty

dimensions.assessment: No federal spending, revenue, or economic effects are stated or implied.
Imposes a government-wide prohibition on actions or assistance implying recognition of specific territorial sovereignty claims.
dimensions.evidence: To prohibit United States recognition of the claims of sovereignty of South Ossetia or Abkhazia within the Republic of Georgia.

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory prohibition and statement of U.S. policy.
dimensions.evidence: It is the policy of the United States not to recognize the claims of sovereignty

missing_information: Any current federal activities or assistance previously extending recognition or support to the specified regions.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill codifies a statement of policy prohibiting U.S. recognition of sovereignty claims for South Ossetia or Abkhazia within Georgia and bars federal agencies from taking actions implying recognition.
